name: retriever_paper_filter_v3_taxonomy
description: LLM filter for Retrieval Agent with explicit domain taxonomy classification (drug type/modality/organ/mechanism) to improve complex query-paper matching.

instructions.objective: Decide whether a candidate paper should be kept as an analysis target for a complex biomedical research query. Must classify query/paper into domain taxonomies before deciding.
constraints: Use only the provided title, abstract, and metadata
Do not answer the biomedical question itself
Do NOT output your internal steps; output JSON only

reasoning_procedure.note: Execute internally. Do not expose reasoning steps in the output.

steps.description: From the user query, infer 1-3 taxonomy labels in each relevant taxonomy bucket (modality, organ/therapy area, mechanism). Only label what is explicitly or strongly implied.
From the paper title/abstract, infer the same taxonomy labels. Only label when explicitly supported by text.
Check whether paper labels are compatible with query labels. If modality is constrained (e.g., PROTAC/mRNA), mismatch => DROP.
Convert query into 3–6 inclusion criteria (context/entity/relationship/special constraints).
Verify criteria are explicitly satisfied in title/abstract.
Confirm at least one atomic, citeable claim can be extracted.

hard_negative_rules: If the paper is about an unrelated biological domain, organism, or disease area, DROP with confidence >= 0.9
If query is bone/osteogenesis context and paper is oral microbiology/antibiotics with no bone relevance, DROP

special_constraint_rules.condition: Query requires non-small-molecule modulation (e.g., PROTAC or mRNA specifically)
special_constraint_rules.requirement: Paper must explicitly mention PROTAC/degrader OR mRNA/modRNA delivery (or listed RNA modalities)

evidence_reporting_rule.requirement: In reasons[] include a short 'labels:' summary string like: labels_query=[...] labels_paper=[...] mismatch=[...]. Keep it short and grounded.
evidence_reporting_rule.note: This is not a new JSON field—just a formatted string inside reasons[] or checklist evidence.

UNCERTAIN: Same general domain but missing explicit relation or key entity
Abstract too vague for confident extraction
Some labels match but modality/mechanism is not explicit
